audience: product and operations teams that send notifications through Courier

useCases.title: Find messages that failed to deliver
useCases.text: List recent messages filtered by status. Get one message and its delivery history, channel by channel, to see each status change.

useCases.title: Review notification templates and brands
useCases.text: List the notification templates and open one to read its routing and state. List the brands that templates can use.

useCases.title: Check a user's contact details and preferences
useCases.text: Get one user profile with the contact details that Courier delivers to. Read the user's notification preferences per topic and channel.

useCases.title: Manage the subscribers of a list
useCases.text: List the subscribers of a list with their preferences. Subscribe a user to the list, or remove the user from it.

useCases.title: Send a notification from a template
useCases.text: Send a template to one recipient, a list or a tenant. Courier sends real messages, so check the recipient first. Cancel a queued message before it is delivered. Pass an idempotency key so a retry is safe.
